instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for dark mode (Deep Navy #040914).
Import Satoshi font from Fontshare in CSS.
Build the landing page with pure HTML + Tailwind to allow maximum creative freedom with GSAP and Three.js.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard, heavily styled to match the glassmorphic, enterprise-command-center aesthetic (border-white/10, bg-opacity).
Integrate cmdk for the Command Palette (⌘K) to quickly jump between FIRs, Cases, and Map.
In the Executive Command Center, build dense metric cards (KPIs, sparklines) ensuring they fit perfectly without feeling cluttered.
For Kavacha AI Copilot, build a chat interface that supports citations/references styling.
Respect the 'Bloomberg Terminal + Linear' density requirement. Do not use excessive padding inside data tables.
Do not use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. Always use a solid dark base or heavy backdrop-blur (bg-[#0B132B]/80).
Ensure the 'data-testid' attribute is on all interactive and key informational elements.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so apply these guidelines to standard JS/JSX components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable, except in data-dense tables where Bloomberg Terminal density is required.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or sonner.jsx.
